logs_mac_o_s_tips_content:
1. If the game cannot run due to 'Developer cannot be verified', go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and click 'Allow Anyway' next to SMAPI or Stardew Valley.
2. Disabled mods are stored inside your game's Mods/ folder with a leading dot (e.g. Mods/.CJBCheats). SMAPI ignores these folders automatically.

logs_health_exp_benign: SMAPI flags these as errors, but they don't break your game.
logs_health_benign_galaxy: GOG Galaxy isn't signed in. Only the Galaxy overlay and its achievements are affected — the game and your mods run normally.
logs_health_benign_api_generic: A mod couldn't connect to another mod's optional feature (usually its in-game settings menu), often because the two versions don't match. The mod still works; only that extra feature is unavailable.
logs_health_benign_optional_generic: A mod mentions a companion mod you don't have. It's optional — the mod works without it, you just don't get that extra feature.
logs_health_benign_parse_generic: A mod couldn't read part of its own data. That's a bug in the mod itself, not something you can fix; a small feature may be missing in-game.
logs_health_sg_duplicate: "%@" is installed twice. Keep one copy in Mods/ and delete the other, otherwise it won't load.
logs_health_sg_game_version: "%@" doesn't support your game or SMAPI version. Check its mod page for an update, or remove it.
logs_health_sg_manifest: "%@" has an invalid or missing manifest.json. Reinstall it from its mod page — the folder is probably incomplete.
logs_health_sg_folder: "%@" is in the wrong folder. Each mod needs its own folder directly inside Mods/, containing its manifest.json.
logs_health_exp_patched: These mods change the game deeply. They're the first suspects if the game becomes unstable.
logs_health_exp_save: These mods change your save format. Back up your saves before playing.
logs_health_exp_broken: Buggy code was loaded anyway; this can cause in-game errors.
logs_health_exp_console: These mods access the SMAPI console directly (more fragile).
logs_health_sg_skipped: "%1$@" couldn't be loaded (%2$@). Check that it matches your game version and has a valid manifest.json.
logs_health_sg_failed: "%1$@" failed to start (%2$@). Check the install instructions on its Nexus page.
logs_health_sg_save: "%@" changes your saves: back them up before continuing, and don't remove it mid-playthrough.
logs_health_sg_broken: Broken mods are loaded. Update them, or disable them to stop in-game errors.
logs_health_sg_patched_many: You have %lld mods changing game code. If the game crashes, disable half of them and relaunch: if the crash stops, the culprit is among them; if not, it's in the other half. Keep halving — about ten tests are enough, even with hundreds of mods.
logs_health_sg_rivatuner: RivaTuner can crash the game with SMAPI. Add Stardew Valley to its exceptions, or close it while playing.
logs_health_sg_error_mod: "%1$@" logged many errors (%2$lld). Check that it matches your game version, or disable it.

bisect_title: Find the mod causing the problem
bisect_intro: Game crashing? I'll pause your mods in halves and restart the game between each step, until we find the one at fault. Nothing gets deleted: everything goes back the way it was.
bisect_reproduce_body: I'll start the game with all your mods, exactly as you have it today. Play until the problem shows up, then come back here.
bisect_paused_count: I'm pausing %lld mods for this step.
bisect_waiting: Over to you. I'll wait here — come back when you know.
bisect_quit_game_first: Quit Stardew Valley first, then answer — I need to move folders the game is holding open.
bisect_hint_crashed: the game stopped on an error
bisect_confirm_body: Everything is back on except "%@". If the problem is gone, that's the one.
bisect_concluded_body: "%@" is causing the problem. It stays paused; leave it that way, or put everything back below.
bisect_restore_incomplete: Some mods could not be switched back on. Close the Finder if it's open on the Mods folder, then try again below.
bisect_log_names_other: Note: the game's log reports errors from "%@", not "%@". The two are likely at odds with each other — removing either makes the problem go away, but neither is solely to blame.
bisect_log_evidence: What the log reported during the search:
bisect_log_suspect_line: %1$@ — %2$lld of %3$lld steps where the problem was present
bisect_appears_only_with: This error only shows up when these mods are on: %@
bisect_inconclusive_body: The problem doesn't come from one mod alone: it shows up when several are on together. The search still narrowed it down.
bisect_not_reproducible_body: The problem didn't happen this time. If it comes back, start the search then.
bisect_restored: Your mods are back to how they started.
bisect_interrupted_body: A search was interrupted on %@. Your mods are still paused. Put them back the way they were?
bisect_cleared_count: %lld mods are already in the clear.
bisect_no_candidates: No mods to test: they're all paused already.
bisect_kept_paused: Everything else is back on; this mod stays paused.

recovery_title: Files a backup can give back
recovery_note: Updating a mod overwrites its whole folder, taking with it what the author does not ship: a French translation installed by hand, your settings. Listed here are only the files that are gone from the mod, or whose backup holds settings the installed file no longer has — a file you simply changed is not a loss.
recovery_empty: Nothing to recover: no backup holds a file the installed mod has lost.
recovery_reason_lost_keys: %lld setting(s) the installed file no longer has
recovery_diff_only_backup: ONLY IN THE BACKUP — CAN BE PUT BACK
recovery_diff_nothing: No difference between the backup and the installed file.
recovery_no_source: No default.json next to this file: the app cannot tell where a key it does not carry should go.
recovery_reason_differs: differs from the backup — compare only
mod_install_dropped_question_many:

mod_install_deposit_message_addon: This archive is not a mod: it holds %1$d file(s) meant for “%2$@”. Anything they replace is backed up first, and you can remove them from that mod's page afterwards.
mod_install_deposit_rollback_incomplete: Nothing was installed, and undoing it did not fully succeed. These files were left as they are: %@
mods_translation_remove_not_tracked: The files were removed, but the change could not be recorded: the translation may show up again on next launch.
mods_compat_enable_title: Turn on a mod reported as broken?
mods_compat_install_title: This mod is reported as broken
mods_compat_health_unknown: %lld mod(s) unknown to smapi.io — no verdict either way
mods_anomaly_duplicate_active: Installed %1$lld times, more than one of them on — SMAPI loads one and ignores the rest: %2$@
mods_anomaly_duplicate_dormant: Installed %1$lld times; only one copy is on: %2$@
mods_supplement_none: Nothing found on Nexus whose title mentions this mod.
mods_supplement_found: %lld mod(s) whose title mentions this one — translations set aside.
mods_supplement_capped: Nexus holds %1$lld results for this name; only the %2$lld most recent were read.
mods_supplement_hint: These are not confirmed add-ons: they are mods that name this one. Check before installing.
mods_link_to_nexus_hint: Installed by hand, so no Nexus page is attached — which is why no update can be spotted. Pick the matching entry below to attach one.
mods_supplement_as_mod: installed as a mod of its own
mods_nexus_identity_none: No mod of this name on Nexus. It may have been removed, renamed, or never published there — two mods out of three with no id are in this case.
mods_nexus_identity_component: This mod is a component of the pack “%@”. A component's name is rarely a Nexus title: search from the pack's page instead.
mods_nexus_identity_found: %lld page(s) could be this mod's — translations set aside.
mods_nexus_identity_hint: Nothing is linked without you: pick the page that is really this mod's. A mod linked to the wrong page follows the wrong updates.
mods_no_update_check: No update check: no Nexus page attached.

profiles_translation_summary: %1$lld of %2$lld keys in French (%3$d%%) — %4$lld translatable mods, %5$lld fully translated.
profiles_translation_all_done: Every translatable mod in this profile is fully translated.

updates_all_verified_up_to_date: All verifiable mods are up to date
updates_unverifiable_title: %lld mod(s) could not be checked via smapi.io
